summary.root_cause_text: The database is read-only ('attempt to write a readonly database'), so POST /orders and the ledger sync fail. The cause is unknown and is probably in the infrastructure (filesystem, permissions or DB mode). No available tool can fix it.
recommended: A human should check why the DB is read-only: disk full, file permissions or mount mode, a DB file swapped or locked, or a failed-over replica. Then restore write access.
After the fix, run check_invariants and confirm the ledger sync resumes.
Don't roll back or restart the worker: the last deploy doesn't match the timing, and neither would fix a read-only DB.
